shared_elements: long pleated robe falling to the feet
fluted or ribbed sleeve cuff / wristband
carved low relief with linear drapery folds
framing band below/beside the figure (rosette band in A, plain border in B)
justification: Both show profile standing figures in long pleated robes with hands closed around a vertical spear shaft, rendered in shallow relief with the same linear fold and ribbed-cuff conventions, and both are set within a bordered field (a rosette band in A). The main difference is that A is a fragmentary close-up of the lower robe and torso of several figures with a floral border, while B preserves a complete single figure with crown, beard, bow and quiver, attributes not visible in A.
